value.title: Dependabot updates with existing pull-request CI coverage
value.summary: Weekly bounded version-update proposals for Cargo and GitHub Actions; source-ready only.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Configure weekly dependency version-update proposals for the existing Cargo workspace and GitHub Actions, with bounded open PRs and the unchanged pull-request quality workflow. This is source preparation, not GitHub activation or observed bot execution.

sections.name: goals
value: Maintain visibility of available Cargo dependency and GitHub Action updates through ordinary reviewable pull requests.
Keep dependency proposals on the existing read-only pull-request CI path without bot-specific privilege escalation.

sections.name: non_goals
value: No dependency or action-version upgrades in this change; no product-code changes.
No npm or other speculative ecosystems, reviewers, auto-merge, private registry credentials or new runtime dependencies.
No commit, push, pull request, merge, visibility change, publication or claim of remote Dependabot activation.

value.claim: The version-2 configuration targets exactly Cargo and GitHub Actions at / on a weekly cadence, limiting open version-update PRs to 5 and 2 respectively, with no speculative ecosystem or dependency upgrade.
value.note: Main validated local YAML/CI source semantics; assets/local-validation.json. Hosted activation/bot execution remains unclaimed.

value.claim: Dependency-update pull requests use the existing pull_request workflow without actor exclusions or additional privileges; the Ubuntu/macOS harness-boot workflow remains unchanged.
value.note: Main validated local YAML/CI source semantics; assets/local-validation.json. Hosted activation/bot execution remains unclaimed.

value.claim: The handoff states that default-branch configuration is required before hosted Dependabot activation, leaves real bot PR/CI execution unclaimed, and introduces no auto-merge, reviewers, credentials, publication or visibility change.

value.title: Dependency update automation
value.brief: Prepare bounded dependency-update configuration and source evidence for Main to validate; remote operation remains unobserved.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Source inspection: Cargo.toml:1-3 declares the root workspace, with dependency declarations at lines 12-33 and a root Cargo.lock. The assignment confirms no tracked npm package manifest. .github/workflows/rust.yml:3-8 enables push and pull_request with contents: read; lines 10-32 contain no actor, branch or path exclusion and invoke harness boot --json on Ubuntu and macOS. checkout and setup-node remain at v4. GitHub documentation: https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/how-tos/secure-your-supply-chain/secure-your-dependencies/configure-version-updates and https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/supply-chain-security/dependabot-options-reference .

value.approach: Main owns all validation after this concurrent batch. Suggested checks: parse the YAML and assert exactly cargo and github-actions at /, weekly schedules and PR limits 5 and 2; run harness plan validate docs/plans/016-dependabot-ci/plan.dd.json. Source inspection confirms the existing pull_request trigger has no actor exclusions. No validation, build, lint or test command was run by this worker.
value.rationale: Source/configuration proof is distinct from GitHub-hosted scheduled execution. An unchanged Rust workflow does not justify a new project-wide test or a fabricated bot run.
value.excluded: No simulated bot identity or local claim of GitHub activation; real update-job and bot-PR CI evidence can only follow authorized default-branch integration.

value.location: This DD product plan and the disarmed scope note in assets/impl-guide.dd.json; generated Markdown is maintained by the local DD writer.
value.rationale: A small configuration change needs a truthful scope/evidence note, not the unrelated text-conversion teaching guide or a second Markdown plan.

sections.name: risks_assumptions
sections.value: Dependabot reads configuration from the default branch. A local branch does not activate GitHub schedules or prove a real bot PR/CI run. The open PR limits constrain version-update PRs per ecosystem, not every security-update PR. The GitHub Actions ecosystem updates action references, not the npm install --global harness version embedded in a shell command. Hosted policy, service health and update availability remain external prerequisites.

sections.name: implementation_summary
sections.value: Added and locally validated .github/dependabot.yml for Cargo and GitHub Actions, weekly with version-update PR limits 5/2. Existing read-only Ubuntu/macOS pull_request CI is unchanged. Source-scoped ACs are verified; no hosted bot execution or activation claim. Main preserves the work in the isolated branch; no visibility change or remote publication.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Only source/configuration ACs are checked, based on assets/local-validation.json; hosted activation remains unobserved.
No formal Builder dispatch, baseline sealing, independent decomposition review or native-root rebinding is claimed.
No dependency/action upgrade, auto-merge, secret, GitHub permission or visibility change.
